Author: topstockalerts
Text: Disney is planning a broad restructuring of its television business that could result in hundreds of job cuts and consolidate divisions that have operated separately, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people familiar with the matter. The plan is being led by Debra OConnell, who oversees ABC Entertainment, 20th Television, Hulu Originals, Disney Kids & Family, National Geographic Content and Freeform. Each unit currently has separate executive leadership overseeing programming across Disney+, Hulu and linear networks, and those positions could be among those affected. Disney Entertainment Television chief Dana Walden said the company plans to centralize the divisions into a single television business rather than separate silos. The details are still being finalized and the restructuring may not be completed before year-end. ABC News is also expected to face additional cuts. $DIS
